name: Hero
title: Hero
summary: The dark, centred home-page hero: gradient photo under a dark overlay, eyebrow, H1 with one emphasised word, lead, two buttons and language chips.
whenToUse: Use once, at the top of the home page and major campaign landing pages (Join the Mission, dot.Bible app).
Use PageIntro for inner pages instead.
whenNotToUse: Do not stack two heroes or put a hero lower on the page.
Do not use on forms, account or app screens.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Eyebrow line above the headline: the organisation or programme name.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline (the page's single h1). Wrap at most one word in `<span className="em">`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Action buttons: one `Button` primary (size lg) and one `outlineDark` (size lg).

props.name: languages
props.description: Language chips shown under the actions.

props.name: languagesLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the language chip group.

props.name: backgroundSrc
props.description: Decorative background photo. Add the dark overlay in CSS; do not lighten it.

props.name: inset
props.description: Rounded corners for a hero placed inside the page frame instead of full bleed.

props.name: headingId
props.description: Id of the h1; generated when omitted.

variantNotes: Full-bleed (default): no radius, 88px top/bottom padding, 64px on mobile.
Inset `.dp-hero-inset`: `--radius-lg` corners, for a hero placed inside the page frame.
Overlay: black gradient 62% → 50% → 70% over the photo so white text keeps contrast on any image.

Language chips: pill, 6% white fill, 18% white border, coloured dot (`--sky-blue`, `.dp-lang-gold`, `.dp-lang-violet`). As links they are 44px tall and lighten on hover. On desktop they may float around the hero.
On dark, `.em` renders as gradient-clipped type and `.eyebrow` switches to `--blue-on-dark`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Add `.on-dark` so eyebrow, `.em`, `.lead` and headings switch to their dark styles.
One `.em` word per headline, never more.
One Horizon Blue primary (`.btn-primary`); the second action is `.btn-outline-light`. Never two blue buttons.
↗ on a button means it goes to another page; omit it for an in-page jump.
Use `.btn-lg` (52px) in the hero. Keep both buttons on one line on desktop; they wrap and centre on mobile.
Background is `deck-bg-gradient-dark.jpg` or another dark brand photo; always keep the overlay.
Headline at most about 12 words; lead one sentence.

accessibility: One `<h1>` per page, and it lives here. Label the section with `aria-labelledby`.
Each language chip sets `lang` on the link so screen readers pronounce the name correctly.
White on the overlay meets AA; do not lighten the overlay.
Respect reduced motion; do not animate the background.
content: Eyebrow: the organisation or programme name in caps ("International Scripture Ministries").
Headline: the promise, plain and warm: "God’s Word, within reach of every language on earth."
Lead: "We make scripture accessible to anyone, anywhere."
Chips show language names in their own script (Español, Kiswahili, 한국어, አማርኛ).
